notes:
No statistics inferred or converted. Repeated identical descriptions are not assigned to labs or tests by input order. Primary authors table values used as supplied; d is not computed here. Replication locator p.13 differs from pagination in current accepted manuscript; explicit extension-pilot description resolved using Supplementary Document II. Original four-category outcome and replication six-category extension retained separately.
Completion source review (n_o): The target pooled contrast spans all three randomized language conditions in the primary Experiment 2 analysis. Explicit mutually exclusive participant-sex groups provide analytic N; separate note-3 sensitivity exclusions are not applied to the primary analysis.
